messages:
infra-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected: anomalous cross-region routing from eu-west -> us-east. Elevated 5xx and p95 latency. Alerting routing-policy-service and lb-frontend.

pagerduty: Paging maya (oncall), samir, diego — incident INC-2026-184002.

maya (oncall): Ack. I’m on it. Looking at metrics and traces.

samir: I’m seeing a spike of 502s with X-Routed-To: us-east. Example trace: 
```
curl -v -H "Host: api.redwood.test" "https://eu-west.api.redwood/test" -I
> GET /test HTTP/1.1
< X-Redwood-Region: eu-west
< X-Routed-To: us-east
< X-Route-Policy: region-pin
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
```

diego: That suggests region pinning evaluated to us-east incorrectly. Any recent policy changes?

elaine (sre): policy-evaluator logs show several region_pin entries with ttl=-1 which triggers fallback logic and then subsequent misroutes/looping: 
```
2026-03-14T22:30:01Z policy-eval region_pin id=ab12 ttl=-1 action=pin -> fallback
```

maya (oncall): Negative TTL? That should never happen. Who deployed policy-evaluator in the last 2 hours?

samir: Deploy history: infra-team rollout at ~22:10 UTC, PR #2234 updated TTL parsing code. Suspect parsing bug introduced there.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cross-region-routing. Recommended immediate steps: 1) set FEATURE_FLAG_REGION_PIN=false, 2) restart policy-evaluator in eu-west, 3) monitor 5xx/latency.

maya (oncall): Flipping FEATURE_FLAG_REGION_PIN=false now to stop pinning.

infra-bot: Feature flag change detected: FEATURE_FLAG_REGION_PIN=false by maya (oncall). Rollout in progress.

samir: After FF flip, 502s on eu-west drop significantly. p50 latency back to baseline but p95 still elevated.

diego: Restarting policy-evaluator pods in eu-west to clear caches: 
```
kubectl -n routing rollout restart deployment/policy-evaluator -l region=eu-west
```

maya (oncall): Restart issued. Watching logs and metrics.

elaine (sre): Post-restart logs show no further ttl=-1 entries and cache eviction events. 502s down to near baseline. Customers impacted: org-alpha and a few API keys; estimated 7% of regional traffic affected for ~12 minutes.

samir: Opening emergency revert PR to remove faulty TTL parser changes: PR #2240.

maya (oncall): Updating status page with a draft: 
"Investigating — We observed an issue with cross-region routing causing a subset of eu-west traffic to be misrouted to us-east resulting in increased errors and latency. Mitigation: disabled region pinning feature flag and restarted the policy-evaluator. Traffic is returning to normal. Root cause under investigation."

maya (oncall): @pagerduty please escalate to Customer Success for customers with >99.9% SLA exposure.

pagerduty: Escalation sent to Customer Success.

diego: Adding an alert rule for negative TTL parse occurrences now. We should catch this automatically.

ops-runbook-bot: Post-incident actions suggested: 1) full postmortem, 2) test harness for region_pin TTL edge cases, 3) infra retro and stricter deploy gating for routing logic.

maya (oncall): Handoff: samir will own overnight follow-up and remediation runbook until 08:00 UTC. Samir, you good?

samir: Acknowledged. Taking handoff. Summary: feature flag flip mitigated immediate impact; emergency revert PR open; monitor p95/502; patch TTL parser next.

maya (oncall): Marking incident as mitigated and closing active paging window. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated, impact=partial, duration=00:24:34, incident_id=INC-2026-184002.

samir: Will lead the postmortem write-up. Assigning diego and elaine to own parser fix and alerting work. Notes saved to incident tracker.

elaine (sre): Post-fix log snippet: 
```
2026-03-14T22:58:12Z policy-eval region_pin id=ab12 ttl=300 action=pin
2026-03-14T22:58:15Z route=eu-west -> eu-west ok
```

maya (oncall): Thanks everyone. If anything regresses ping samir directly. Handoff complete. :slightly_smiling_face:
